requirements.description: User prefers properties near healthcare services. Value set to the 75th percentile (75.06, rounded to 75) of the healthcare distribution, the threshold for 'near' proximity.

The user explicitly requires at least 360 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 360. The capacity of 18 people is not converted into an area threshold. The future use as a CDIA does not affect the current typology. The proximity to healthcare services is a location criterion for the Location Agent.

output.explanation: Filters on property type (offices), surface area of at least 360 sqm, healthcare proximity score of at least 75, and a 3.0 km radius around the supplied coordinates. Results are ordered by distance from that point. Capacity for 18 people has no matching filterable column, so it is not applied.
